fieldValues.title: A response to a comment is a typed comment on it; conversation stays flat
fieldValues.decision_question: How does a writer's judgement on a comment (thumbs up or down, a task done or rejected) get recorded, and does that open threaded replies?
fieldValues.context:
Owner, 2026-10-21, live in a Claude Code conversation. Remedies 0aa77274 (comment kinds; tasks ticked or rejected) and 7f697a33 (thumbs up or down) need the writer to judge a comment an agent created (srs-programme#189). Storing the judgement as fields on the agent's comment loses its provenance: the response is the writer's, not the agent's. The package already allows the alternative: com.semanticops.comments/comments-on is "Comment comments on any record", so a comment can target a comment.
Prior owner ruling, recorded here for the first time (semanticops.com#17, 2026-10-02, ruling 3): no threading; a flat sequence per paragraph ordered by createdAt; a reply is a later comment. Under 0b1c25b1 an owner ruling written elsewhere is recorded as a decision before it is cited or changed.
fieldValues.friction: Ruling 3 lived only in an issue body, so changing it first meant recording it.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
(a) Fields on the comment (task_state, verdict): simplest read, but the writer edits the agent's record and the judgement's provenance is lost. Rejected by the owner.
(b) Typed response comments, response kinds only (chosen): a judgement is the writer's own comment that comments-on the target comment; only response kinds may target a comment; shown as a badge on the target.
(c) Any comment may reply to any comment: general threads; supersedes ruling 3. Not now.
(d) Do nothing: comments stay text only and both remedies cannot land.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Every judgement keeps its own author (createdBy) and time. The current state is readable without guessing. Conversation between writer and agents stays a flat sequence per paragraph.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A writer's judgement on a comment is a comment of its own that comments-on the target comment, with a response kind: agree or disagree (the thumbs), done or rejected (a task; the text is the reason). Only response kinds may target a comment; every other comment targets a record that is not a comment, and conversation stays a flat sequence per paragraph (ruling 3 of semanticops.com#17 stands for conversation). The current verdict or task state is the latest response by that author; changing one's mind is a new response, and history is kept. Clients show responses as badges on their target, not as nested replies.
fieldValues.rationale: A response is testimony of the person who gave it (RFC-046): it belongs in a record they created. The mechanism already exists (comments-on targets any record), so this adds kinds, not structure, and leaves general threads open as a later, separate choice.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A writer needs to reply in words to a specific comment, or a second person writes on the same essay.
